headline: Kathmandu Owner KMD Brands Ends Takeover Discussions With Bluestar
summary: New Zealand-listed retailer KMD Brands terminated non-binding acquisition discussions with US brand management firm Bluestar Alliance.
why: KMD Brands owns prominent outdoor apparel labels including Kathmandu and Rip Curl, making its takeover status central to Australasian retail sector activity.

impacts.name: KMD Brands
impacts.why: Ending takeover talks removes acquisition premium expectations from share prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
